resource_index.note: The post links providers. Product mapping accuracy is not forecast accuracy.

fields.name: date
fields.description: UTC observation date; original daily CRW time is 12:00Z

fields.name: site_id
fields.description: Stable fixed-grid identifier; not a surveyed reef ID

fields.name: hotspot
fields.description: SST minus maximum-monthly-mean climatology; only >=1 contributes to DHW

fields.name: dhw
fields.description: Trailing 84-day accumulation of HotSpot>=1 divided by 7; not field bleaching

fields.name: ssta
fields.description: SST anomaly against the daily climatology

fields.name: spatial_support
fields.description: Fixed satellite-cell support, distinct from field geometry

fields.name: source
fields.description: Upstream product identity, not the original-download URL

datasets.name: NOAA Coral Reef Watch
datasets.structure: time x latitude x longitude grid, extracted to fixed-pixel/day rows
datasets.use: forecast satellite DHW exactly at t+7/t+14; no biological bleaching labels
datasets.evaluation: MAE/RMSE, event days, first crossing, calibration and time blocks; project-defined

datasets.name: Reef Check Malaysia
datasets.use: local evidence; offline field-import adapter validates separate observations

map_schema_review.overlap_definition: Published coordinates inside 0.05-degree cell bounds; location uncertainty not modelled

datasets.evaluation: Independent field comparisons require same-site/date/depth/method observations; no expanding regional percentages to daily labels

datasets.name: Allen Coral Atlas
datasets.structure: 5m geomorphic/benthic/reef_mask raster; WFS polygons retain source attributes
datasets.use: spatial context and cell overlap, never DHW or bleaching labels
datasets.license: Map data CC BY 4.0; separate Planet imagery terms; local AOI only

join_contract.time_series: Exact observation date + fixed centre; no interpolation
join_contract.habitat: Polygon intersection with 0.05-degree cells; equal-area CRS, not square degrees
join_contract.field_observations: Preserve method/depth/denominator/time; coordinates within selected cell; satellite association is not ecological truth

evaluation_contract.new_v2_analysis: Exploratory after viewing v1 test/replay, not a new untouched holdout
evaluation_contract.future_validation: Freeze a protocol before genuinely unseen future data and independent sites
